purpose: High-density desktop dashboard system: container-query minmax grids, sidebar-adaptive layouts, system-font typography, WCAG compliance.
use_when: Building a high-density desktop dashboard feed with container queries and minmax grid columns that adapt to sidebar and inspector width
Implementing sidebar-adaptive layouts with collapsible navigation and right inspector drawers for observability dashboards
Applying system-font stacks, tabular numerals, subpixel rendering, and WCAG focus and contrast rules to dashboard UI
do_not_use_when: Designing a new marketing landing page or app visual identity (use anthropic__frontend-design)
Reviewing UI code for Web Interface Guidelines accessibility compliance (use vercel__web-design-guidelines)
Tuning React bundle or render performance of existing code (use vercel__vercel-react-best-practices)
scope: Only touch files the task names; everything else read-only.
disambiguator: Building desktop dashboard grids, sidebar-adaptive layouts, and system-font WCAG typography -> this. Doing general visual or landing-page design -> anthropic__frontend-design. Auditing UI for guideline compliance -> vercel__web-design-guidelines.
